import time,sys,random,json,copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
import importlib.util
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mm','/app/submit/main.py')
mm=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(mm)
rng=random.Random(5)
for t in range(30):
    t0=time.time()
    n = rng.choice([0,1,2,3,8,25])
    fib=[];seen=set()
    while len(fib)<n:
        L=rng.choice([0,1,2,4,8,16,24,32,48,64,80,96,112,120,127,128])
        net=(rng.getrandbits(L)<<(128-L)) if L else 0
        if (net,L) in seen: continue
        seen.add((net,L)); fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536)))
    S = rng.choice([4,5,6,7,8]); ms = rng.choice([32,32,20,40]); ms=min(32,ms)
    while True:
        cuts=[0]; ok=True
        for i in range(S-1):
            hi = min(ms, 128 - cuts[-1] - (S-1-i))
            if hi < 1: ok=False; break
            cuts.append(cuts[-1] + rng.randint(1, hi))
        if not ok: continue
        last = 128 - cuts[-1]
        if last < 1 or last > ms: continue
        cuts.append(128); break
    caps=[rng.choice([10**6, 10**8, 10**9]) for _ in range(S)]
    st,used = ref.spec_nodes(fib, cuts)
    from fractions import Fraction
    pk=max(Fraction(u,c) for u,c in zip(used,caps))
    img={'status':'ok','capacities':caps,'max_stride':ms,'cuts':cuts,'stages':st,'used_bits':used,'peak':{'num':pk.numerator,'den':pk.denominator}}
    addrs=[]
    for _ in range(60):
        if fib and rng.random()<0.6:
            net,L,h = fib[rng.randrange(len(fib))]
            addrs.append(ref.fmt(net + (rng.getrandbits(128-L) if L<128 else 0)))
        else:
            addrs.append(ref.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)))
    r = mm.check_image(img)
    print(t, n, S, ms, 'check', r is not None, round(time.time()-t0,3), flush=True)
